scientific_result: On the 72 unseen modality-task pairs, DAgger and exposure-matched continued SFT each achieved 1 invariant-valid success; DAgger had one paired win, one paired loss and 70 ties. DAgger did not outperform the random-valid control, which achieved 45 successes.

source_evidence.independent_replay: PASS: all 405 DAgger comparison episodes independently replayed
